principle: Keep three business workflows; compose selected adapters and rule modules inside their extension points

slots.purpose: Receive an authorized document or existing invoice
Map structured fields or selected extraction output to the same invoice contract
Apply customer rules such as PO matching, country tax checks or vendor requirements
Choose routing, authorized reviewers and approval levels
Recheck the current invoice, approval and finance requirements
Use a selected ERP adapter under the finance operation contract
Store the confirmed case according to retention policy

extensionRules: Implement and register an allowlisted module with a pinned version, contract, owner, dependencies and cost budget
Enable it only for the relevant customer and selected workflow
Validate its dependencies and permissions before enabling the workflow; missing capability blocks activation
Route uncertain or unsupported outcomes to review; never silently skip required checks
Plugins cannot bypass mandatory controls or grant authority to the agent
Switch providers at a controlled boundary; never replay a finance write merely because its adapter changed
